outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly three tasks and exactly two cohorts, named alpha and beta, neither depending on the other. T1: a composite counts each finding once per task and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). T2: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T3: a drilldown's nested lists page separately (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). Cohort alpha carries T1 and T2. Cohort beta carries T1 and T3. T1 is the same task in both cohorts, under the same id.
The operator authorizes this audit path: each builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. Each builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and runs `bun test --timeout=120000 oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts` once at the inspected commit. It publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output from both runs. If PostgreSQL is unavailable, the targeted DBOS test run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. Database-backed tests skipped because OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent are not passed tests; include the skip or unavailability in tests.summary or tests.output and in known_issues. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
Each assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task of its cohort, naming that task id. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and briefs short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: The audit is implementable without an operator decision. Local refs resolve the audit head to c03533340ab94eb521315a29d0e76a9219c9b906, and repository code and tests directly support the exact three-task/two-cohort topology and T1-T3 behavior. Two non-blocking verification gaps need specification corrections: the observation-only command does not run T2 tests, and database-backed T1/T3 tests are skipped here because OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset.

findings.description: The requested topology is representable without duplicating T1: workflow-config/development.yaml:276-283 validates an acyclic cohort graph, requires every task in at least one cohort, enforces uniqueness only within a cohort, and explicitly permits the same task id in another cohort. Exactly three tasks and independent alpha/beta cohorts can therefore share T1 as specified.

T1 matches the repository. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:147-158 emits each occurrence once when any matching relation reaches a task, and observation/src/grading/composite.ts:314-372 filters and counts per stage. observation/tests/composite.test.ts:198-218 covers one task shared across cohorts, :238-260 keeps stages separate, and :361-375 proves duplicate paths count one item.

T2 is implemented and tested, but the prescribed builder command cannot execute its package tests. oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:758-785 checks approval of the exact tasks revision before journaling, and :792-807 couples an approval and its links transactionally. oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:90-121 verifies exact-revision behavior, while observation/package.json:6-10 runs only observation/tests.

T3 matches the repository. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:425-461 defines independent windows for rows, questions, links, statuses, current answers, and superseded answers and applies each to its own list. observation/tests/composite.test.ts:377-455 advances outer and nested windows separately while checking complete totals.

The required observation run may finish while skipping its principal T1/T3 integration evidence. observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:21-22 selects test.skip when OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent and CI is not true; that variable is currently unset, and the relevant composite cases in observation/tests/composite.test.ts:198-455 use the integration wrapper. Skips must be reported as known issues, not passes.

requirements.description: Audit that a composite counts each finding occurrence once per logical task and keeps stages separate in observation/src/grading/composite.ts.
Audit that a declaration is journaled only after approval of its exact tasks revision in oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts; add relevant DBOS test evidence.
Audit that drilldown rows and nested lists paginate through independent windows with complete totals in observation/src/grading/composite.ts.
